name: Stripe
tagline: Stripe's full product surface, line by line — which products are judged in an arena of their own, and which have no arena where they honestly compete yet.

subProducts.name: Payments
subProducts.blurb: Online payment acceptance: cards, wallets, 100+ local methods, hosted Checkout, Payment Links, and embeddable Elements.

subProducts.name: Terminal
subProducts.blurb: In-person payments with card readers and smart terminals, unified with online payments in one dashboard and API.

subProducts.name: Atlas
subProducts.blurb: Delaware C corp or LLC incorporation from anywhere: state filing, EIN, founder equity, 83(b) election, and legal templates for a $500 one-time fee.

subProducts.name: Clerky
subProducts.blurb: Startup legal paperwork platform (incorporation, SAFEs, board consents, hiring docs) — a Stripe company, judged as its own product in the same arena as Atlas.
subProducts.acquired: Acquired by Stripe (2026) — still operates and competes as its own product

subProducts.name: Billing
subProducts.blurb: Subscription management and recurring billing: plans, trials, usage-based pricing, revenue recovery, and dunning.

subProducts.name: Metronome
subProducts.blurb: Usage-based billing and contracts platform (billable metrics, commits/credits, marketplace invoicing) — a Stripe company, judged as its own product in the same arena as Stripe Billing.
subProducts.acquired: Acquired by Stripe (Dec 2025) — still operates and competes as its own product

subProducts.name: Invoicing
subProducts.blurb: Global invoicing for one-off and subscription charges with hosted payment pages and automatic reconciliation.
subProducts.note: Separately priced per paid invoice and usable without subscriptions, so judged as its own entry alongside Stripe Billing (founder GO 2026-10-08).

subProducts.name: Connect
subProducts.blurb: Multi-party payments for platforms and marketplaces: seller onboarding, split charges, and payouts.
subProducts.note: No platform-payments arena; the marketplace-split-payments story is judged inside Stripe's payments entry.

subProducts.name: Radar
subProducts.blurb: Machine-learning fraud prevention with risk scoring, custom rules, and review queues on every charge.

subProducts.name: Tax
subProducts.blurb: Automated sales tax, VAT, and GST calculation, registration monitoring, and filing.
subProducts.note: No tax-compliance arena yet; the automatic-tax-calculation story is judged inside Stripe's payments entry.

subProducts.name: TaxJar
subProducts.blurb: US sales tax calculation, nexus tracking, and AutoFile for SMBs — a Stripe company since 2021, still sold standalone ($39-$99/month) and judged as its own product in the same arena as Stripe Tax, whose US filing it powers.
subProducts.acquired: Acquired by Stripe (Apr 2021) — still operates and competes as its own product

subProducts.name: Issuing
subProducts.blurb: Create and manage virtual and physical cards programmatically, including stablecoin-backed card programs.
subProducts.note: No card-issuing arena yet — nothing honest to rank it against.

subProducts.name: Treasury
subProducts.blurb: Banking-as-a-service API for platforms to embed financial accounts: store, spend, and move money (US/UK preview).
subProducts.note: An embedded-finance API for platforms, not an account a startup opens directly — the startup-banking arena ranks banks you can sign up for, so listing Treasury there would be dishonest.

subProducts.name: Capital
subProducts.blurb: Revenue-based financing offers for eligible Stripe merchants, repaid from a share of sales.
subProducts.note: Revenue-based financing offers gated on Stripe processing history — no public product surface to evidence and no merchant-financing arena, so honestly not judgeable.

subProducts.name: Identity
subProducts.blurb: ID document verification, selfie matching, and SSN validation in 30+ countries.

subProducts.name: Financial Connections
subProducts.blurb: Permissioned access to customers' bank account data — balances, ownership, transactions — for ACH and underwriting.

subProducts.name: Revenue Recognition
subProducts.blurb: Automated accrual accounting over Stripe transactions with audit-ready reports and GL export.
subProducts.note: A revenue subledger over Stripe data sold with Billing, not general-purpose accounting — the accounting arena (QuickBooks, Xero) isn't an honest fit; its automation stories are judged inside the billing-subscriptions entry.

subProducts.name: Sigma
subProducts.blurb: SQL reporting environment over your own Stripe data, inside the dashboard — also queryable by agents through the MCP server's stripe_analytics tool.
subProducts.note: Queries only your Stripe data — not a general warehouse, so the data-warehouses arena isn't an honest fit; its agent surface (stripe_analytics MCP tool) is evidenced inside Stripe's payments entry.

subProducts.name: Data Pipeline
subProducts.blurb: No-code export of Stripe data to Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, or cloud storage.
subProducts.note: A single-source export of Stripe's own data — the data-pipelines arena ranks general ELT platforms, so no honest fit.

subProducts.name: Managed Payments
subProducts.blurb: Merchant-of-record variant of Payments: Stripe handles tax, fraud, disputes, and transaction-level support for digital goods sellers.
subProducts.note: A merchant-of-record configuration of Payments (waitlist, 35+ countries — quoted from its docs) — judged inside Stripe's payments entry, not as a separate competitor.

subProducts.name: Lemon Squeezy
subProducts.blurb: Merchant-of-record platform for selling digital products and SaaS (payments, subscriptions, global sales tax, licensing). Its team now builds Stripe Managed Payments, and Lemon Squeezy users are being offered a migration path to it.
subProducts.note: A Stripe line, not an independent competitor: per its own 2026 update (lemonsqueezy.com/blog/2026-update), the MoR product's successor is Stripe Managed Payments (waitlist, 35+ countries) — judged inside Stripe's payments entry.
subProducts.acquired: Acquired by Stripe (2024) — team now builds Stripe Managed Payments; LS users get a migration path to it.

subProducts.name: Crypto & Stablecoins
subProducts.blurb: Stablecoin payments, payouts, and fiat-to-crypto onramp; stablecoin balances and card programs in preview.

subProducts.name: Agentic Commerce
subProducts.blurb: Both sides of agent commerce: Agentic Commerce Suite catalog feeds sold through agents over UCP/ACP, machine payments (MPP/x402) with shared payment tokens and stablecoins, the Link agent wallet + Link CLI, and embedded agent checkout.

subProducts.name: Directory
subProducts.blurb: A search index of businesses, Stripe Apps, Projects providers, and pay-per-call MPP endpoints that developers and agents query from the CLI (`stripe directory search --format json`) to find and engage providers.
subProducts.note: A discovery layer in preview, not a standalone judged product; its agent-facing surface is evidenced inside Stripe's payments entry.

subProducts.name: Projects
subProducts.blurb: Provision and manage third-party services (hosting, databases, auth, AI, observability) from 60+ providers via the CLI or a coding agent, with credentials synced to .env and billing consolidated through Stripe.
subProducts.note: Closest arena would be infra provisioning, where it is an orchestrator of other vendors rather than a competitor; its agent-facing surface is evidenced inside Stripe's payments entry.

subProducts.name: Climate
subProducts.blurb: Carbon-removal purchasing: recurring revenue commitments or one-time orders via Frontier.
subProducts.note: Carbon-removal purchasing via Frontier. A neighboring carbon-API set exists (Patch, Lune, Cloverly — watchlist bring-up), but they broker many projects while Climate buys Frontier offtake — a different job, so no honest arena today.

name: Adyen
tagline: Adyen's single-platform product lines, judged in their own arenas where they honestly compete; the rest scored inside the payments entry or unranked.

subProducts.name: Online Payments
subProducts.blurb: Global online card and local payment-method acceptance on Adyen's single platform.

subProducts.name: In-Person Payments
subProducts.blurb: In-person payments with Adyen terminals — same platform, APIs, and reporting as online.

subProducts.name: Adyen for Platforms
subProducts.blurb: Marketplace and platform payments: onboarding, split payments, and payouts for multi-party businesses.
subProducts.note: No platform-payments arena; the marketplace-split-payments story is judged inside Adyen's payments entry.

subProducts.name: Orb
subProducts.blurb: Usage-based billing and metering platform — an Adyen company since July 2026 ($335M), still sold standalone and judged as its own product in the billing-subscriptions arena.
subProducts.acquired: Acquired by Adyen (Jul 2026) — still operates and competes as its own product

subProducts.name: Risk Management
subProducts.blurb: Machine-learning risk engine for fraud screening and dispute defense.

subProducts.name: Issuing
subProducts.blurb: Issue physical and virtual cards on Adyen's platform.
subProducts.note: No card-issuing arena yet.

subProducts.name: Adyen Agentic
subProducts.blurb: Agentic-commerce infrastructure: a Product Feed API syndicating catalogs to OpenAI and Meta, Agentic Cart checkout sessions, and ACP/UCP integrations for both merchants and agent platforms.

subProducts.name: Adyen Uplift
subProducts.blurb: AI payment optimization: tailored recommendations and experiments balancing conversion, risk, and cost across the full payment funnel.
subProducts.note: A platform capability, not a separate product; the AI-insights and fraud stories it feeds are judged inside Adyen's payments entry.

name: Block
tagline: Block's brands product by product: both judged Square lines and Buzz, plus the consumer brands with no arena.

subProducts.name: Square Payments
subProducts.blurb: Square's developer payments platform: online card acceptance, subscriptions, invoices, and payouts APIs.

subProducts.name: Square Point of Sale
subProducts.blurb: Square's in-person point of sale: readers, terminals, registers, and Tap to Pay.

subProducts.name: Buzz
subProducts.blurb: Open-source team workspace where AI agents are first-class members — launched publicly in July 2026.

subProducts.name: Cash App
subProducts.blurb: Consumer payments, banking, and investing app.
subProducts.note: Consumer finance app — no consumer-payments arena yet.

subProducts.name: Afterpay
subProducts.blurb: Buy-now-pay-later installments, still independently branded under Block.
subProducts.note: No BNPL arena.

subProducts.name: Square AI
subProducts.blurb: AI assistant built into the Square Dashboard (Beta): natural-language questions over a seller's own sales and inventory data, augmented with local web data like weather, events, and reviews.
subProducts.note: A feature of the seller platform, judged inside Square's payments entry (built-in assistant and AI-insights stories).

name: PayPal
tagline: PayPal's brands product by product: the judged payments flagship plus Braintree, Venmo, Hyperwallet, and Fastlane — page-only where no arena honestly fits.

subProducts.name: PayPal Payments
subProducts.blurb: Global checkout, invoicing, subscriptions, payouts, and disputes APIs — plus the agent toolkit, a hosted remote MCP server, and the Agent Ready agentic-commerce integrations.

subProducts.name: Braintree
subProducts.blurb: Gateway and processing platform with a first-class GraphQL API and its own SDK surface; the processing rails behind Agent Ready's ACP and UCP integrations.
subProducts.note: Not separately tracked — gateway capabilities and the Agent Ready rails it powers are judged inside PayPal's payments entry.
subProducts.acquired: Acquired by PayPal (2013) — still operates as its own developer platform

subProducts.name: Venmo
subProducts.blurb: Consumer P2P payments and social wallet; accepted as a payment method in PayPal and Braintree checkouts.
subProducts.note: Consumer wallet — no consumer-payments arena yet.

subProducts.name: Hyperwallet
subProducts.blurb: Global payout infrastructure for marketplaces and platforms: bank, card, and wallet disbursements across 200+ markets.
subProducts.note: Payout infrastructure — no payouts arena; the payouts stories PayPal competes on are judged inside its payments entry.

subProducts.name: Fastlane
subProducts.blurb: Accelerated guest checkout by PayPal: recognizes shoppers across merchants for one-tap card checkout without a PayPal login.
subProducts.note: A checkout-acceleration feature sold with PayPal and Braintree processing; judged inside PayPal's payments entry.

name: Mercury
tagline: Mercury's banking product plus the card, treasury, invoicing, and personal lines around it — one judged entry, the rest honestly unranked.

subProducts.name: Business Banking
subProducts.blurb: FDIC-insured business checking and savings with ACH, wires, and accounting integrations.

subProducts.name: Mercury Books
subProducts.blurb: Full double-entry accounting built into the Mercury account: automatic categorization, real-time reconciliation, P&L / balance sheet / cash flow reports, and Command AI for journal entries and chart-of-accounts work. Free for all of 2026, then $35/month.

subProducts.name: IO Corporate Card
subProducts.blurb: IO corporate charge card with 1.5% cashback and no personal guarantee.
subProducts.note: Card capabilities are scored inside Mercury’s startup-banking entry; Mercury is not ranked in the expense-management arena while its spend product ships only bundled with banking.

subProducts.name: Treasury
subProducts.blurb: Cash-management account (from $250k) that invests idle cash for yield.
subProducts.note: Scored inside Mercury's startup-banking entry, where treasury-yield stories live; no standalone treasury arena.

subProducts.name: Invoicing
subProducts.blurb: Send invoices and get paid by card, ACH, or wire, inside the same banking dashboard.
subProducts.note: No invoicing arena; invoicing capability is scored inside Mercury's startup-banking entry where its stories apply.

subProducts.name: Bill Pay
subProducts.blurb: Vendor bill payment with approval workflows and accounting sync.
subProducts.note: Scored inside Mercury's startup-banking entry; no standalone bill-pay arena.

subProducts.name: Personal Banking
subProducts.blurb: High-yield personal accounts and debit card — one $240/year plan, included free with any active Mercury business plan.
subProducts.note: Consumer product — outside the startup-banking arena's scope, and no personal-banking arena exists.

subProducts.name: Venture Debt
subProducts.blurb: Term loans for VC-backed startups.
subProducts.note: Lending product — no financing arena.

subProducts.name: Command
subProducts.blurb: AI financial assistant that executes banking tasks with human approval.
subProducts.note: A feature of the banking product, judged inside Mercury's startup-banking entry (built-in assistant and automation stories).

subProducts.name: Spend Management
subProducts.blurb: Expense management free with Mercury banking: budgets, employee reimbursements, receipt scanning, AI GL categorization, and cards for teams and agents.
subProducts.note: Launched Aug 2026; still bundled with Mercury banking (standalone "coming soon"), so it stays scored inside Mercury’s startup-banking entry — the expense-management arena ranks standalone spend platforms and will revisit if Mercury Spend ships standalone.

subProducts.name: Insights
subProducts.blurb: AI analytics free on all plans: dashboards, auto-categorization, and cash-flow alerts across accounts.
subProducts.note: A feature of the banking product, judged inside Mercury's startup-banking entry (AI-insights stories).

subProducts.name: SAFEs
subProducts.blurb: Create, sign, send, and track SAFE fundraising documents from the dashboard, free for C-corps, with funds routed to Mercury.
subProducts.note: Covers only the SAFE-issuance slice of legal-ops' job — it would na out of nearly the whole arena (incorporation, compliance, contracts), so judging it there would be noise, not signal.

subProducts.name: Working Capital Loans
subProducts.blurb: Flat-fee short-term loans for ecommerce brands with $250k+ annual sales, repaid on fixed weekly schedules.
subProducts.note: Lending product — no financing arena.

subProducts.name: Central (Payroll & HR)
subProducts.blurb: AI-native payroll, benefits, and HR administration for startups; still sold and operated standalone during integration.
subProducts.note: A payroll arena exists (Gusto, Rippling, Deel, Justworks), but Central's public surface is a JS-rendered marketing site with no crawlable docs — judging it today would punish the crawl gap, not the product. Watchlist bring-up.
subProducts.acquired: Acquired by Mercury (2026) — operates standalone during integration

name: Notion
tagline: The connected workspace plus its companion apps — one judged entry; Notion Mail excluded as it shuts down September 2026.

subProducts.name: Notion Workspace
subProducts.blurb: The core connected workspace: docs, wikis, databases, and projects.

subProducts.name: Notion Calendar
subProducts.blurb: Connected calendar app across work and personal schedules.
subProducts.note: A calendar client — the scheduling arena ranks booking infrastructure, a different job, so no honest fit.

subProducts.name: Notion AI & Agents
subProducts.blurb: Built-in assistant, AI meeting notes, enterprise search, and configurable AI teammates.
subProducts.note: Features of the workspace, judged inside Notion's project-management entry (built-in assistant and automation stories).

name: Atlassian
tagline: Atlassian's suite product by product: Jira, Trello, and Bitbucket judged in their arenas, the rest mapped honestly.

subProducts.name: Jira
subProducts.blurb: Project and work management for software teams.

subProducts.name: Bitbucket
subProducts.blurb: Git hosting with built-in CI/CD (Pipelines).

subProducts.name: Confluence
subProducts.blurb: Team knowledge base and documentation.
subProducts.note: An internal wiki — the docs-platforms arena ranks public developer-docs publishing and notes-knowledge ranks personal tools, so no honest fit yet.

subProducts.name: Trello
subProducts.blurb: Kanban boards for lightweight project tracking.

subProducts.name: Jira Service Management
subProducts.blurb: ITSM and help desk built on the Jira platform.
subProducts.note: No ITSM arena; the incident-management arena ranks on-call/incident response tooling, an adjacent but different job.

subProducts.name: Rovo
subProducts.blurb: Atlassian's AI layer: search, chat, and agents across Jira and Confluence, with an MCP server.
subProducts.note: A cross-product AI layer, judged where it surfaces inside Jira's project-management entry (assistant and automation stories).

name: Intercom
tagline: Fin and the products around it — the AI agent is judged; the human-agent helpdesk lines have no arena yet.

subProducts.name: Fin
subProducts.blurb: The AI support agent resolving customer queries across chat, email, and voice.

subProducts.name: Helpdesk
subProducts.blurb: AI-powered omnichannel helpdesk and ticketing for human agents.
subProducts.note: A human-agent helpdesk — the ai-support-agents arena judges autonomous agents, and no helpdesk arena exists yet.

subProducts.name: Proactive Support
subProducts.blurb: Outbound messaging: product tours, banners, checklists, and sequences.
subProducts.note: No customer-messaging arena.

name: Shopify
tagline: The commerce platform plus its POS, agentic, payments, and consumer lines — judged where an arena honestly fits.

subProducts.name: Shopify Platform
subProducts.blurb: The core commerce platform: storefronts, checkout, admin, and developer APIs.

subProducts.name: Shopify POS
subProducts.blurb: In-person retail selling synced with the online store: hardware, staff, and inventory.

subProducts.name: Shopify Payments
subProducts.blurb: Built-in payment processing for Shopify stores.

subProducts.name: Shop
subProducts.blurb: The consumer shopping and package-tracking app with Shop Pay.

subProducts.name: Shopify Agentic Commerce
subProducts.blurb: Shopify's UCP surface for agents: the Global Catalog MCP, per-storefront /api/ucp/mcp endpoints for carts, checkouts, and orders, agent profiles with auth and rate limiting, and the @shopify/ucp-cli.

name: Google
tagline: Google's AI product surface mapped by capability — eight judged lines from the Gemini app to Antigravity and Gemini Notebook, plus honest cards for Flow, AI Studio, and Gemini in Chrome.

subProducts.name: Gemini
subProducts.blurb: Chat with grounded answers, generate and edit images (Nano Banana), run Deep Research, build docs and apps in Canvas, and schedule actions — across web, mobile, and desktop apps.

subProducts.name: Antigravity
subProducts.blurb: Run and supervise fleets of coding agents from a command center, IDE, CLI, or SDK — parallel worktrees, browser-in-the-loop verification, artifact review, skills, and MCP.

subProducts.name: Gemini CLI
subProducts.blurb: Open-source terminal agent for querying and editing large codebases with Gemini. Consumer tiers moved to Antigravity CLI in June 2026; this remains the API-key and Code Assist path.

subProducts.name: Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM)
subProducts.blurb: Upload your own sources — PDFs, Docs, audio, YouTube — and get answers grounded only in them with citations, then turn them into reports, mind maps, slide decks, flashcards, and Audio or Video Overviews.

subProducts.name: Jules
subProducts.blurb: Assign a GitHub issue and get a reviewed plan, diff, and pull request back — an asynchronous coding agent on cloud VMs with a REST API and CLI.

subProducts.name: Agent Development Kit
subProducts.blurb: Build, evaluate, and deploy multi-agent systems in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, or Kotlin, and ship them to Cloud Run or the Agent Platform.

subProducts.name: Google AI Studio
subProducts.blurb: Prototype with Gemini models, generate media, grab an API key, and vibe-code deployable apps in the browser — free.
subProducts.note: The developer console for the Gemini API; its app-building surface sits behind login, and vibe-coding ranks products whose whole job is prompt-to-app (Lovable, Bolt, v0). Watchlist for a Build-mode bring-up.

subProducts.name: Flow
subProducts.blurb: Make cinematic AI video and images with scene-level control and reusable ingredients — the creative studio that absorbed Whisk and ImageFX, running Veo and Gemini Omni.
subProducts.note: No image/video-generation arena exists yet (roadmap: image-generation planned) — nothing honest to rank it against.

subProducts.name: Gemini in Chrome
subProducts.blurb: Summarize and compare across open tabs, ask about the page you are on, and let auto-browse finish tasks in the browser.
subProducts.note: A paid-tier feature of Chrome and the Gemini subscription, not a separately adopted product; the browsers arena is planned, not live.

subProducts.name: Gemini Code Assist
subProducts.blurb: In-IDE completion, chat, and agentic multi-step edits for Google Cloud organizations under enterprise compliance controls.
subProducts.note: Individual tiers ended June 2026 (migrated to Antigravity); what remains is an enterprise SKU of capability already judged via Antigravity and Gemini CLI.

subProducts.name: Firebase
subProducts.blurb: App-development backend platform: auth, databases, hosting, and functions.

subProducts.name: Angular
subProducts.blurb: Google's TypeScript web application framework.

subProducts.name: Google Workspace
subProducts.blurb: Gmail/Docs/Meet productivity suite that doubles as a workforce IdP: Cloud Identity directory, SAML app catalog, provisioning, and the Admin SDK.

subProducts.name: Google Drive
subProducts.blurb: Cloud file storage and sync — Drive API v3 (files, changes, permissions, revisions), shared drives, and the Workspace editors on top.

subProducts.name: Google Cloud
subProducts.blurb: The hyperscaler platform — gcloud CLI, Terraform provider, IAM with workload identity federation, and Vertex AI.

subProducts.name: Gmail
subProducts.blurb: The default inbox of the internet — 1.8B+ accounts, now judged as an email client and agent surface: Gmail API sends and reads mail under OAuth scopes, Pub/Sub push watches inboxes, and Gemini drafts inside the client.

name: Microsoft

subProducts.name: Microsoft Copilot
subProducts.blurb: Microsoft's AI assistant across Windows, web, and Microsoft 365.

subProducts.name: Windows

subProducts.name: Microsoft Teams
subProducts.blurb: Team chat, meetings, and collaboration.

subProducts.name: AutoGen

subProducts.name: Visual Studio Code
subProducts.blurb: The open-source code editor.

subProducts.name: Microsoft Azure
subProducts.blurb: The hyperscaler platform — az CLI, Bicep/ARM, RBAC and managed identities, Cost Management, and AI Foundry.

name: GitHub
tagline: GitHub product by product: hosting, Copilot, and Mobile each judged in their own arena.

subProducts.name: GitHub
subProducts.blurb: Code hosting, pull requests, and collaboration.

subProducts.name: GitHub Copilot
subProducts.blurb: AI pair programmer and coding agent across IDEs and github.com.

subProducts.name: GitHub Mobile
subProducts.blurb: GitHub on iOS and Android: triage, review, and merge on the go.

subProducts.name: GitHub Actions
subProducts.blurb: CI/CD and workflow automation on every repository.
subProducts.note: CI/CD capability is judged inside GitHub's code-hosting entry (its CI stories); no standalone CI arena.

name: OpenAI
tagline: OpenAI's product surface mapped by capability: the judged five plus honest cards for images, Work, ChatKit, and the platform — and the lines that shut down, documented, not hidden.

subProducts.name: ChatGPT
subProducts.blurb: Ask, research the web, and delegate whole tasks that come back as reviewable docs, decks, sites, and spreadsheets — one app across web, desktop, and mobile with projects, memory, and scheduled automations.

subProducts.name: dots
subProducts.blurb: Always-on personal agents that keep work moving between conversations: each dot has its own cloud computer and browser, reachable from ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, and voice calls, with approval checks before actions.

subProducts.name: ChatGPT Work
subProducts.blurb: Define an outcome and ChatGPT plans the work, browses in a cloud browser, uses your files and plugins, and returns a finished deliverable you review.
subProducts.note: A mode of ChatGPT (it replaced agent mode in July 2026), sold on the same plans — judged inside the chatgpt entry's long-running-work and agents stories; a second row would double-list one product.

subProducts.name: Image generation (GPT-Image-2.5)
subProducts.blurb: Generate and edit images in conversation — text-to-image, precise edits from reference images — and the same capability via the API (GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst and Flare).
subProducts.note: A capability of ChatGPT and the API, not a separately adopted product — and no image-generation arena exists yet (roadmap: planned). Its in-app stories are judged inside the chatgpt entry.

subProducts.name: Codex
subProducts.blurb: A coding agent that writes, tests, reviews, and ships code — CLI, IDE extension, cloud sandboxes, Slack/Linear/GitHub integrations, and Codex Remote from your phone.

subProducts.name: Codex Security
subProducts.blurb: Scan repositories for vulnerabilities from a plugin, CLI, SDK, or the cloud, with adversarially-checked findings your team triages.
subProducts.note: A Codex sibling launched September 2026; security-scanners ranks established GA scanners — bring-up candidate once it has a record beyond launch week.

subProducts.name: Agents SDK
subProducts.blurb: Build agent loops with handoffs, guardrails, and sessions in TypeScript or Python — the open framework track alongside the hosted Agents API.

subProducts.name: Plugins
subProducts.blurb: Package skills, MCP servers, and UI into plugins that run in both ChatGPT and Codex, distributed through a reviewed public directory with checkout-based monetization.

subProducts.name: ChatKit
subProducts.blurb: Embed a production chat UI over your own agent backend: a widget with streaming, attachments, and theming, shipped from npm.
subProducts.note: A developer component (beta API), not a product users adopt on its own; no embeddable-AI-UI arena exists.

subProducts.name: Agents API
subProducts.blurb: Run agents on OpenAI-hosted infrastructure — the managed Codex harness with sessions and sandboxes, callable from your backend.
subProducts.note: Beta hosted-agents surface of the API platform; proprietary model platforms aren't an arena we rank yet (roadmap: frontier-model-apis).

subProducts.name: API Platform
subProducts.blurb: The developer platform: Responses API, Realtime voice with SIP calls, hosted tools, containers, and fine-tuning.
subProducts.note: Proprietary model APIs are not an arena we rank — inference-providers ranks hosts of open models, a different job (roadmap: frontier-model-apis).

name: Anthropic
tagline: Anthropic's product surface mapped by what you can do with each line: five judged products from the assistant app to Claude Design, and honest not-yet-judged cards for the rest.

subProducts.name: Claude
subProducts.blurb: Ask, research with citations, analyze files, and build artifacts in one assistant across web, desktop, and mobile — with memory, connectors, and voice that carry across every surface.

subProducts.name: Claude Code
subProducts.blurb: Ship code end-to-end from the terminal, IDE, web, or CI: explore a codebase, edit files, run commands, and open the PR — with subagents, skills, hooks, and MCP.

subProducts.name: Claude Design
subProducts.blurb: Turn a written brief into interactive prototypes, decks, and marketing collateral: apply your own design system, refine with inline comments and sliders, and hand off to Claude Code to ship. An Anthropic Labs beta.

subProducts.name: Claude Cowork
subProducts.blurb: Hand Claude a folder and an outcome: it works through files, browsing, and multi-step office tasks in parallel sessions you review — the Claude Code harness for non-coders.
subProducts.note: A surface of the Claude app subscription, not separately adopted — its delegate-whole-tasks capabilities are judged inside the claude entry's agents-tasks stories; a second row would double-list one product.

subProducts.name: Claude Agent SDK
subProducts.blurb: Build your own agents on the same harness as Claude Code: the agent loop, tools, hooks, MCP, and skills as TypeScript and Python libraries.

subProducts.name: Anthropic Skills
subProducts.blurb: Package instructions, scripts, and resources into SKILL.md folders that Claude loads on demand — portable across the app, Claude Code, Cowork, and the API.

subProducts.name: Claude in Chrome
subProducts.blurb: Claude acts in your browser: navigate, fill forms, and run web tasks from a side panel with per-site permissions and action confirmations.
subProducts.note: No browsers arena yet (roadmap: planned), and browser-agents ranks developer automation frameworks — judging a consumer extension there would be the wrong axis (same call as Perplexity Comet).

subProducts.name: @Claude (Slack & Teams)
subProducts.blurb: Tag @Claude in a Slack or Teams thread to summarize, answer with workspace context, run analysis, and carry out standing instructions.
subProducts.note: A bot that lives inside team-chat products, not a chat platform — ranking it against Slack itself would be the wrong axis; the underlying assistant is judged as claude.

subProducts.name: Claude for Microsoft 365
subProducts.blurb: Work inside Office: interrogate and update Excel models cell by cell, draft Word docs with tracked changes, build decks from your templates, and triage Outlook.
subProducts.note: An integration surface of the Claude subscription inside Microsoft's apps — no office-suite arena, and the underlying assistant is already judged as claude.

subProducts.name: Claude Science
subProducts.blurb: A workbench for scientists: query scientific databases, run reproducible analyses on managed compute, visualize proteins and genomic data, and draft the manuscript alongside.
subProducts.note: Beta. ai-research-agents ranks literature-review agents (Elicit, Consensus, FutureHouse); a compute-and-analysis workbench is a neighboring but different job. Watchlist line.

subProducts.name: Claude Security
subProducts.blurb: Point it at a codebase to find vulnerabilities, adversarially validate which findings are real, and get patch suggestions your team reviews.
subProducts.note: Enterprise public beta; security-scanners ranks GA scanners any developer can adopt today (Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy). Bring-up candidate once generally available.

subProducts.name: Managed Agents
subProducts.blurb: Host agents on Anthropic-run infrastructure straight from the API: managed sandboxes, stateful sessions, and scheduled runs without operating your own harness.
subProducts.note: Beta surface of the developer platform; proprietary model platforms aren't an arena we rank yet (roadmap: frontier-model-apis).

subProducts.name: Claude Developer Platform
subProducts.blurb: The API platform: Messages API, tool use, code execution, files, and agent infrastructure for building on Claude.
subProducts.note: Proprietary model APIs are not an arena we rank — inference-providers ranks hosts of open models, a different job (roadmap: frontier-model-apis).

subProducts.name: Vercel

subProducts.name: Vercel Sandbox

subProducts.name: Vercel AI Gateway

subProducts.name: skills.sh

subProducts.name: Cloudflare Sandboxes

subProducts.name: Cloudflare AI Gateway

subProducts.name: Registrar

subProducts.name: LangGraph
subProducts.blurb: Graph-based orchestration framework for stateful agents.

subProducts.name: LangSmith
subProducts.blurb: Tracing, evals, and observability for LLM applications.

subProducts.name: Browserbase
subProducts.blurb: Hosted headless browser infrastructure for automation at scale.

subProducts.name: Stagehand

name: Pipedream

subProducts.name: Pipedream
subProducts.blurb: Developer-first workflow automation across thousands of app integrations.

subProducts.name: Pipedream MCP
subProducts.blurb: Hosted MCP servers exposing those integrations to agents.

name: Cursor
tagline: The AI editor and its code-review agent, judged separately.

subProducts.name: Cursor
subProducts.blurb: The AI-native code editor and agent.

subProducts.name: Cursor Bugbot
subProducts.blurb: AI code review on pull requests.

name: Perplexity
tagline: The answer engine, its API, the Computer agent, and the Comet browser — three judged, one with no arena.

subProducts.name: Perplexity
subProducts.blurb: Cited, real-time AI answer engine.

subProducts.name: Sonar API
subProducts.blurb: Grounded search and LLM API family.

subProducts.name: Comet
subProducts.blurb: AI-powered Chromium browser.
subProducts.note: No browser arena; the browser-agents arena ranks automation frameworks, not consumer browsers.

subProducts.name: Perplexity Computer
subProducts.blurb: A general-purpose agent that runs long tasks in the background — web browsing, a Linux code sandbox, document and media creation, email and calendar — with an OAuth MCP server and a 400+-service connector framework.

name: Kong
tagline: Kong's full product surface, line by line — the gateway platform, the AI gateway, and Insomnia are judged in arenas of their own; the mesh, event, and Konnect service lines have no arena where they honestly compete yet.

subProducts.name: Kong Gateway & Konnect
subProducts.blurb: API gateway (open-source core plus Enterprise) and the Konnect SaaS control plane that runs it: routing, auth, rate limiting, declarative config, analytics.

subProducts.name: AI Gateway
subProducts.blurb: LLM gateway proxying 15+ model providers behind one OpenAI-compatible API: load balancing and fallbacks, token rate limits, semantic caching, prompt guards, and MCP/A2A traffic governance.

subProducts.name: Insomnia
subProducts.blurb: Open-source desktop API client for designing, debugging, and testing APIs: collections, environments, mock servers, Git sync, and the inso CLI for CI.
subProducts.acquired: Acquired by Kong (2019) — still ships and competes as its own open-source API client

subProducts.name: Kong Mesh
subProducts.blurb: Enterprise service mesh built on CNCF Kuma: mTLS, service discovery, and traffic management across Kubernetes and VMs.
subProducts.note: No service-mesh arena — nothing honest to rank it against.

subProducts.name: Event Gateway
subProducts.blurb: Kafka-native proxy between clients and clusters: virtual clusters, policy enforcement, schema validation, and topic-level auth (Konnect-only).
subProducts.note: No event-streaming arena.

subProducts.name: Ingress Controller & Operator
subProducts.blurb: Kubernetes packaging of the gateway: Ingress/Gateway API resources translated into Kong config; new features now land in Kong Operator.
subProducts.note: A deployment form of Kong Gateway, judged inside Kong's api-platforms entry — not a separate competitor.

subProducts.name: Dev Portal
subProducts.blurb: Customizable API developer portal: publish OpenAPI/AsyncAPI plus Markdown docs with self-service credentials (Konnect-only).
subProducts.note: A Konnect platform service; the generate-publish-api-docs story is judged inside Kong's api-platforms entry.

subProducts.name: Service Catalog & MCP Registry
subProducts.blurb: Inventory and governance of APIs, AI models, agents (beta), and MCP servers (tech preview) across the organization (Konnect-only).
subProducts.note: A Konnect platform service; the internal-api-catalog story is judged inside Kong's api-platforms entry. MCP Registry is tech preview.

subProducts.name: Kong Identity
subProducts.blurb: OAuth 2.0 authorization server centralizing token issuance for APIs fronted by Kong runtimes (Konnect-only).
subProducts.note: Auth for Kong-managed API traffic, not standalone developer login infrastructure — the auth-platforms arena (Auth0, Clerk, WorkOS) does a different job.

subProducts.name: decK & kongctl
subProducts.blurb: Declarative-config CLI for the gateway (decK) and the Konnect platform CLI (kongctl) for APIs, portals, AI Gateway, and catalog resources.
subProducts.note: Tooling for the platform, judged inside Kong's api-platforms entry (official-CLI, headless, and declarative-config stories).

subProducts.name: Metering & Billing
subProducts.blurb: Usage-based metering and monetization of APIs, LLM tokens, and event streams inside Konnect, built from OpenMeter.
subProducts.note: No API-monetization/usage-billing arena.
subProducts.acquired: Built from OpenMeter, acquired by Kong (2025)

subProducts.name: Volcano SDK
subProducts.blurb: Open-source TypeScript agent SDK: MCP-native, multi-provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex...), with parallel/branch/loop flows and OpenTelemetry.
subProducts.note: Launched late 2025 — a young entrant next to the agent-frameworks arena's incumbents; watchlist bring-up candidate, not judged in this mapping.

name: Postman
tagline: Postman's platform line by line — the API client platform and the acquired Fern docs product are judged in their arenas; Flows, Insights, and the 2026 agent stack have no arena where they honestly compete yet.

subProducts.name: API Client & Collections
subProducts.blurb: Multi-protocol API client (HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, AI and MCP requests) with collections, workspaces, spec-first design, testing, and Vault-managed secrets.

subProducts.name: Fern
subProducts.blurb: Hosted API documentation sites and SDK generation from OpenAPI specs, with agent-facing features like llms.txt, markdown endpoints, and MCP servers.
subProducts.acquired: Acquired by Postman (2026) — still operates and competes as its own docs & SDK product

subProducts.name: Flows
subProducts.blurb: Low-code visual workflow runtime: API orchestrations with loops, TypeScript blocks, and AI steps, deployed to run on webhooks and schedules or as MCP tools.
subProducts.note: Real deployed automation, but with ~7 app connectors and no standalone sale it plays the developer-HTTP slice — judging it against workflow-automation's app-integration breadth (Zapier, Make, n8n) would misrepresent it.

subProducts.name: Mock Servers
subProducts.blurb: Cloud mock servers generated from saved examples, plus gRPC mocks and local JavaScript mocks.
subProducts.note: Judged inside Postman's api-platforms entry (mock-servers-from-examples story).

subProducts.name: Monitors
subProducts.blurb: Scheduled cloud collection runs for uptime and regression checks, with static IPs and private runners on Enterprise.
subProducts.note: Judged inside Postman's api-platforms entry (scheduled-api-monitors story).

subProducts.name: Postman CLI & newman
subProducts.blurb: Signed first-party CLI for collection runs, governance checks, and coding-agent commands; newman is the legacy open-source runner with an official migration path.
subProducts.note: Judged inside Postman's api-platforms entry (run-tests-in-ci and headless stories).

subProducts.name: API Network & MCP Catalog
subProducts.blurb: Public directory of APIs, workspaces, and MCP servers; Private API Network for internal catalogs on Enterprise.
subProducts.note: A directory, not a competing product; the internal-api-catalog story is judged inside Postman's api-platforms entry.

subProducts.name: Agent Mode
subProducts.blurb: Natural-language AI agent inside the app and cloud: fixes requests, writes tests, generates docs, and organizes collections, metered by AI credits.
subProducts.note: Postbot's successor — a built-in assistant judged inside Postman's api-platforms entry (built-in-assistant and NL-command stories).

subProducts.name: Insights
subProducts.blurb: Agent-based API observability: drop an agent into K8s/ECS/EC2, discover live endpoints, and monitor errors feeding the API Catalog (Enterprise-only).
subProducts.note: API-endpoint observability, not general observability (metrics/logs/traces) — the observability arena isn't an honest fit.
subProducts.acquired: Built from Akita Software, acquired by Postman (2023)

subProducts.name: API Catalog & Governance
subProducts.blurb: Enterprise system of record for APIs with gateway/repo connectors, scorecards, and Spectral-based governance rules enforced in the CLI.
subProducts.note: Enterprise governance of the same platform; internal-api-catalog and lint-specs stories are judged inside Postman's api-platforms entry.

subProducts.name: SDK Generator
subProducts.blurb: Generate and maintain SDKs and CLIs from collections and specs, with GitHub auto-PR sync.
subProducts.note: No SDK-generation arena; Fern (also a Postman company) is the judged docs-platforms line.
subProducts.acquired: Built from liblab, acquired by Postman (2025)

subProducts.name: AI Engineer
subProducts.blurb: Autonomous cloud agent on Postman's Context Graph: API exploration, design review, root-cause analysis, and PR testing in a sandboxed environment.
subProducts.note: Early access (June 2026) — too early to judge, and no existing arena honestly fits an API-scoped autonomous engineer.

subProducts.name: Fabric Gateway
subProducts.blurb: Self-hosted gateway routing and governing AI, MCP, and API traffic across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, and more (AWS/GCP/Azure).
subProducts.note: Early access while launch customers onboard, and absent from Postman's pricing — a model-gateways watchlist candidate once GA, not judged before.

subProducts.name: Passport
subProducts.blurb: Credential-brokering proxy for agents: agents hold credential references while secrets resolve inside your VPC with scoped, time-limited delegation.
subProducts.note: Beta/early access, and no secrets-management arena exists.

name: Linear
tagline: Linear is one app with one data model — the judged core plus the three genuinely separable adoption surfaces around it; everything else the site names (Insights, Customer Requests, Triage Intelligence) is a plan-gated feature, not a product line.

subProducts.name: Linear
subProducts.blurb: Issue tracking, projects, cycles, and initiatives for product teams — the core app every other surface hangs off.

subProducts.name: Asks
subProducts.blurb: Internal ticketing: requests filed from Slack, email, or web forms — by people without Linear accounts — become triaged Linear issues (Business and Enterprise plans).
subProducts.note: A genuinely separate adoption surface, but no internal-ticketing/ITSM arena exists, and its output is ordinary Linear issues judged inside the parent entry.

subProducts.name: Linear for Agents
subProducts.blurb: Third-party coding agents (Cursor, Devin, Codex, Sentry Seer...) join the workspace as assignable teammates via the agents directory, remote MCP server, and Agent Sessions API.
subProducts.note: A platform surface of the same workspace — its agent-facing capabilities (MCP server, GraphQL API, webhooks) are judged inside the parent entry's agenticness stories.

subProducts.name: Coding Sessions
subProducts.blurb: Delegate agentic coding from an issue: Claude Code or Codex runs in a sandbox, drafts PRs, and returns reviewable diffs — usage-priced via AI credits.
subProducts.note: Orchestrates third-party coding agents rather than being one — judging it in ai-coding against the very agents it hosts would double-count them.

name: xAI
tagline: xAI's product surface — Grok, Grok Bot, and Grok Build judged in their arenas, with honest cards for Grok Imagine, Grokipedia, and the API.

subProducts.name: Grok
subProducts.blurb: Chat by text or voice, analyze files, generate images and video with Imagine, and connect Gmail, Drive, Teams, Salesforce, and custom MCP tools — on the web, iOS, Android, and inside X.

subProducts.name: Grok in X
subProducts.blurb: Ask Grok from the X timeline: summarize threads and replies, explain posts with real-time X context, and generate images without leaving the feed — included with X Premium.
subProducts.note: A distribution surface of the same Grok assistant inside X (bundled with X Premium, operated with X Corp) — judged inside the grok entry; its real-time-answers capability scores there where the arena's research stories apply.

subProducts.name: Grok Build
subProducts.blurb: A terminal coding agent: explore, edit, and run code with plan mode, subagents, worktrees, skills and plugin marketplaces, MCP, and headless scripting — installed with one curl.

subProducts.name: Grok Bot
subProducts.blurb: Named, persistent AI teammates on cloud computers — browser, filesystem, terminal — that take multi-step tasks, learn skills by demonstration, and run scheduled routines; bundled with Cursor plans.

subProducts.name: Grok Imagine
subProducts.blurb: Generate and edit images and video — multi-image editing, image-to-video, cinematic aspect ratios — inside the Grok app and via the Imagine API.
subProducts.note: A capability of Grok and the API, not a standalone app; no image-generation arena exists yet (roadmap: planned).

subProducts.name: Grokipedia
subProducts.blurb: Browse and search an AI-written and AI-maintained encyclopedia.
subProducts.note: A content destination, not a tool with user stories we rank — no encyclopedia or reference arena.

subProducts.name: xAI API
subProducts.blurb: Build on Grok models with one key: text and reasoning, image and video generation, speech-to-speech phone agents over SIP, RAG collections, and server-side tools.
subProducts.note: Proprietary model APIs are not an arena we rank yet (roadmap: frontier-model-apis) — inference-providers ranks hosts of open models, a different job.

name: Ultrametric

subProducts.name: Foreloop
subProducts.blurb: Agent-run software production: turns product intent into implemented, reviewed code. Waitlist-gated pre-launch; also judged in Product Feedback & Intent.

subProducts.name: AFK
subProducts.blurb: Computer-use agent sessions that keep working while you step away; waitlist-gated pre-launch behind an Ultrametric account.

subProducts.name: Ultrametric Rankings & Data API
subProducts.blurb: This site: evidence-graded product rankings served as a read-only keyless data API — /data/*.json, openapi.json, and llms.txt for agents (all fetch-verified live 2026-09-29).
subProducts.note: Never self-judged: verdicts on our own platform would be self-refereeing, and the API is a single-source export of this site's own data — the same reason Stripe Sigma and Data Pipeline stay page-only.

subProducts.name: Ultrametric CLI & MCP

subProducts.name: Ultrametric (company-records CLI)
subProducts.blurb: Shipped npm package `ultrametric` (0.4.1, 2026-09-24): company-setup process guides and reusable company records for AI agents. A separate product from the rankings CLI/MCP.
subProducts.note: No fitting arena: legal-ops ranks incorporation and filing platforms, and agent-facing guidance plus records would na out of nearly every story (the Mercury SAFEs precedent). Distinct from the /v2 rankings CLI despite the shared npm scope.
